protocol: Judged from the captured images only, before reading any agent label. One to two frames per event (the leading shower's az-055 frame, plus a second azimuth where the first was ambiguous). This is a LIGHTER pass than the agents' 3-9 frames: it can catch a gross mis-call, and it cannot adjudicate an under-clustering finding that rests on the acceptance plot. Events where my pass cannot decide are marked not_adjudicated rather than forced into a verdict.
